title: ieee80211: Add Aruba GPS Ellipse
description:
This merge request adds support for dissecting HPE Aruba Networking GPS Ellipse data from beacons/probe responses. This vendor IE contains location information including latitude, longitude, ellipse dimensions, orientation, and distance values.

![image](/uploads/36a74d1c9c4b591bb2ed22f05eaf3a4b/image.png){width=2444 height=1566}
